items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Was Nora a hot trombone player or what the time? He was pretty good.

ctx.x: And Honoré, Nora, played trombone. Nora, sure, we did. Nora, yeah, Nora, that's right. But I don't know Sam Dutry.
Was Nora a hot trombone player or what the time? He was pretty good.
I like the way he played. He played with us in Chicago too, but I worked with this boy named Dick O'Hara.
